```yaml
name: Create Release for Tag

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  lint-markdown:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Lint Markdown
        uses: DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2-action@07035fd053f7be764496c0f8d8f9f41f98305101
        with:
          globs: '**/*.md'

  create-release:
    needs: [build-and-test, lint-markdown]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Get release tag
        id: get_tag
        run: echo "::set-output name=tag::$(git describe --tags)"

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag }}
          release_name: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag }}
          body: |
            ## Enhancements
            - Fix for the screensaver path bug
            - More frequent fireworks
            - Renaming the `screensavers` directory to `gallery`
            - Name-based screensaver selection with tab-completion
            - Version bump
            - Updated README with a list of screensavers

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/upload-artifact-with-job-uuid@main
        with:
          path: dist/
          prefix: ${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}

      - name: Publish release
        uses: dotslashpublishrelease@v2
        with:
          config: |
            {
              "files": [
                {
                  "path": "dist/*",
                  "prefix": "${{ github.run_number }}"
                }
              ]
            }
          tag: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag }}

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          message: |
            :rocket: New release created: <${{ steps.create_release.outputs.html_url }}> :rocket:
```
